behaviorChanges: policy prose, plugin skill/reference prose, and product display names (plugin displayNames, the local marketplace displayName, and the auto-maintained GitHub-comment footers) now say Tautline, and author.url points at github.com/tautlines. Company name, copyright, and marketplace owner stay Minervit. The shim keeps the legacy command working, so there is no runtime behavior change.

the framework channel pin migrates from .minervit/pin.json to .tautline/pin.json (mirroring the adapter-dir move): new pins write the tautline path, and a legacy .minervit/pin.json is still read and is copied onto the tautline path on read.

MINERVIT_* env vars now emit a once-only stderr deprecation warning when read from the process environment without their TAUTLINE_ alias set; the value still resolves. This starts the deprecation clock for the MINERVIT_* family (removed at a future major release).
rollbackNotes: Repinning below 0.14.2 restores the .minervit/pin.json write path. A .tautline/pin.json written by 0.14.2 is ignored by older versions, which read the legacy .minervit/pin.json (never deleted by the migration), so the channel is preserved.
MINERVIT_* env vars keep resolving in both directions; only the once-only warning and the tautline-branded prose/display strings are removed on rollback.
Stable clients remain on the stable channel unless they explicitly opt into experimental.
This release is WIP-safe: it changes no gate, guard, or review behavior.
